description: Look up normalized filter values for Apollo searches: seniority, employee_range, revenue_range, department, title or industry. Free and local: no network call, no credits. Use it before sdr_search_people or sdr_search_companies to turn plain-English ICP terms into exact values (for example query "vp eng" returns "VP Engineering"). Returns up to `limit` matches.

kind.description: Which filter taxonomy to look up.

query.description: Fuzzy search text, e.g. "vp eng". Omit to list the first values.

name: sdr_lookup_filters
title: Look up filter values
